turns.answer: I found no error counters at all — obi's stored history shows zero in and out errors on that interface on both tamarack-gw and basswood-gw across that window, so this wasn't a bit-error or CRC problem. The syslog confirms it was a physical link flap: sfp-sfpplus9-tamarack-ptp-basswood-70 went link down at 2:10:57 and back up at 2:10:58, ten gig full duplex, and OSPF re-established full adjacency by 2:11:08. The Siklu radio for that 70 gig hop is currently up and healthy, about minus 42 dBm RSSI with good CINR, so it looks like a brief blip rather than an ongoing RF or error problem — want me to check further back in the logs for any pattern of repeated flaps?
